name: org_graph_change_unit_kind
description: Change the unit type of a unit Espalia holds, from effective_on (today by default). The new type must be one Espalia supplies, must be able to sit under the unit's parent (or at the top), and every live sub-unit must be able to sit under it, on every day from effective_on to today. effective_on can't be after today or before the unit's last change of type. Only a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor can change a unit's type.
